title: Pinecone Legacy API key (bare UUID): one-property twin (context)
summary: 12 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: Api-Key header renamed X-Project-Id; the UUID is kept byte-for-byte. A bare UUID beside a Pinecone project/index/database/service-account id name is a public identifier shape, not a legacy key, context: PINECONE_API_KEY renamed PINECONE_DATABASE_ID; the UUID is kept byte-for-byte. A bare UUID beside a Pinecone project/index/database/service-account id name is a public identifier shape, not a legacy key, and context: PINECONE_API_KEY renamed PINECONE_INDEX_ID; the UUID is kept byte-for-byte. A bare UUID beside a Pinecone project/index/database/service-account id name is a public identifier shape, not a legacy key, and 9 more. Twin of "Pinecone Legacy API key (bare UUID): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
